text:
How on the high plain your figure

appears to me!... My word evokes

the green meadow and the arid plain,

the flowering bramble, the ashen rock.


And obedient memory, a black holm oak

sprouts on the hill, the poplar descends to the river;

the shepherd climbs up to the hill;

a balcony of the city shines: mine,


ours. Do you see? Toward Aragon, far off,

the Moncayo range, white and rose...

Look at the blaze of that crimson cloud,


and that star in the blue, wife.

Beyond the Duero, the hill of Santana

turns purple in the silent afternoon.

translation.title: As on the High Plain Your Figure
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the landscape summoned by memory and the intimate turn from mine to ours.
